title: Unified Trading System — Workspace Manifest v2
description: SSOT for all repos: types, dependencies, doc standards, merge order. Drives CI/CD, completeness checkers, service doc rollout, and quickmerge cascade.
notes: Updated 2026-02-28: (1) UDC arch_tier corrected to 3 (was 2 — codex+DAG SSOT is T3). (2) MEL arch_tier corrected to 0 (pure compute leaf). (3) Added 4 orphan repos: execution-results-api, market-data-api, client-reporting-service, strategy-ui. (4) Added features-sports-service and unified-sports-execution-interface as workspace-scaffolded repos (status: planned). (5) Added completion_paths section (CeFi, DeFi, Sports, TradFi). (6) Tier_rules updated to 5-tier model. (7) UMI→UDC dep violation flagged. Original: Promoted from DEPENDENCY-MATRIX-CANONICAL.json. corporate-actions removed (operational mode within instruments-service). 2026-02-28: Added unified-trading-pm, deployment-ui, infra, strategy-validation-service; deleted execution_services.

versions_policy.rule: All versions MUST be <1.0.0 until the repo passes a full quickmerge on main via the new CI/CD pipeline (Phase 0-CI complete). Version 1.0.0 is the first STABLE release — it is only set by the GitHub Action auto-bump on merge to main, never manually. No version in this manifest should be >=1.0.0 until that repo's tier is fully green.
versions_policy.bump_authority: GitHub Action (version-bump.yml) on merge to main only. Conventional commit prefix determines bump type.
versions_policy.local_bumps: FORBIDDEN on branches. Only the GitHub Action bumps versions. Manual bumps cause double-bump (local + CI = skipped semver).
versions_policy.pre_stable_convention: 0.MINOR.PATCH — minor reflects architectural evolution; patch reflects fixes. 0.x.x means not yet validated as stable on the new CI/CD pipeline.
versions_policy.stable_threshold: 1.0.0+ = passed full quickmerge on main with Phase 0-CI infrastructure in place.

versions._note: All versions reset to 0.x.x (2026-02-28). Nothing was stable under the old CI/CD — versions >=1.0.0 were aspirational. 1.0.0 will be set by GitHub Action on first successful main merge per repo. 0.x.y preserves relative evolution (e.g. UTS 0.2.2 reflects more history than AC 0.1.0).

unified-internal-contracts.notes: Internal message schemas, topic names, request/response/error contracts. NO cloud SDKs.

unified-reference-data-interface.notes: REST-only reference data: instrument definitions, options chains, expiry calendars, corporate actions. Phase 8 of io_interface plan.

unified-cloud-interface.notes: Cloud abstraction layer: storage, pub/sub, logging. Tier 0 pure leaf.

unified-trading-services.notes: GitHub repo renamed from unified-trading-services. Local folder still named unified-trading-services. Package: unified_trading_services (alias) + unified_trading_services (internal).

unified-domain-client.notes: TIER 3: Cloud storage I/O layer — reads/writes GCS/S3 domain data. Imports T0 (UCLI, UCI, UEI) + T1 (UTS). arch_tier corrected from 2→3 on 2026-02-28 per canonical DAG and codex SSOT (04-architecture/TIER-ARCHITECTURE.md).

matching-engine-library.notes: TIER 0: Pure order matching algorithms — zero inter-library deps. arch_tier corrected 2→0 on 2026-02-28. Any current UTS/UCI deps in source must be removed.

known_violations: ⚠️ TIER VIOLATION: unified-domain-client (T3) listed as dep. T2 must only import T0+T1. Remove UDC dep — see cohesion-umi-udc-dep-violation in consolidated plan.

dependencies.name: unified-domain-client
dependencies._violation: T2→T3 lateral import — must be removed

unified-sports-execution-interface.notes: Scaffolded 2026-02-28. BaseSportsAdapter protocol exists. Betfair (CLOB via UTEI) and Pinnacle adapters planned v1.0.0. NOT required for CeFi/TradFi completion.

unified-position-interface.notes: Not yet built. Planned: per-client position feeds, normalises exchange-native format to canonical CanonicalPosition. Consumers: execution-services, position-balance-monitor-service.

features-sports-service.notes: Scaffolded 2026-02-28. Computes pre-match ML features (team form, H2H, referee, venue, weather, market odds). NOT required for CeFi/TradFi completion.

strategy-service.deployment_note: One instance per client (separately managed accounts)

execution-services.deployment_note: Per-client deployment — holds client order credentials. Category splits: CeFi/DeFi/TradFi.

position-balance-monitor-service.deployment_note: Shared service — serves many clients. One instance per workspace.

strategy-validation-service.notes: Scaffolded 2026-02-28. T+1 backtest vs live recon.

execution-results-api.notes: FastAPI + OAuth middleware. HTTP boundary between execution-services and UIs. P0: replace dict[str, Any] at all API boundaries with TypedDict/Pydantic (p0-exec-results-api-types).

market-data-api.notes: FastAPI + OAuth middleware. Exposes processed market data to UIs. SSE endpoint for live price streaming.

client-reporting-service.notes: FastAPI + OAuth middleware. Client-facing reporting API. Aggregates PnL, positions, fills for external clients.

strategy-ui.notes: Strategy configuration and deployment UI. Calls strategy-service via FastAPI. OAuth (TRADER role).

unified-trading-deployment-v3.notes: Being split into deployment-engine + deployment-api + deployment-ui + system-integration-tests. See task deployment-v3-four-way-split.

deployment-engine.notes: Python orchestrator + CLI + Terraform + configs. Extracted from unified-trading-deployment-v3. Owns Layer 2 (infra verification) via scripts/verify_infra.py.

deployment-api.notes: Thin FastAPI wrapper around deployment-engine. GoogleOAuthMiddleware on writes. Triggers Layer 2+3 tests post-deploy.

deployment-ui.notes: React UI calling deployment-api. OAuth ADMIN scope for trigger buttons.

system-integration-tests.notes: Layer 3a (smoke) + Layer 3b (full E2E) integration tests. Not in the tier DAG — sits above all tiers. Interacts via HTTP/GCS/PubSub only, zero Python imports from services. SSOT: 06-coding-standards/integration-testing-layers.md

live-health-monitor-ui.notes: Hybrid: monitoring dashboard + manual trading control (calls execution-services /manual/instruction)

settlement-ui.notes: Settlement UI — empty directory, not yet implemented.

unified-trading-pm.description: Project management SSOT — workspace-manifest.json, credentials-registry.yaml, plans/ai/, cursor-rules/
unified-trading-pm.notes: DevOps/PM repo. Contains workspace SSOT (workspace-manifest.json), cursor rules, AI plans. Not a code library.

deployment-ui.description: Deployment management UI — orchestrator status, shard progress, Cloud Build logs, IBKR Gateway config UI
deployment-ui.notes: UI split from unified-trading-deployment-v3 per ui-service-separation rule. React/TypeScript. Scaffolded 2026-02-28. After four-way split: depends on deployment-api.

deployment-engine.description: Deployment orchestration engine — Python package (orchestrator, catalog, config_loader, backends), Terraform, configs. Layer 2: verify_infra.py (infra connectivity gate).

deployment-api.description: Deployment API — thin FastAPI with OAuth; imports deployment-engine; triggers Cloud Build; triggers system-integration-tests post-deploy.
deployment-api.notes: Extracted from unified-trading-deployment-v3 four-way split. Port 8001.

system-integration-tests.description: Layer 3a (fast smoke) + Layer 3b (full pipeline smoke). Sequential: 3a must pass before 3b. Triggered by deployment-api post-deploy. Requires GCP sandbox.
system-integration-tests.notes: Standalone repo per new-repo-setup.md. Not a library or service. SSOT: 06-coding-standards/integration-testing-layers.md
